notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
Hello all awesome patrons of Pet Squad Racing!
To all who have downloaded and tried it, a big Thank You!

Since the release, I made the choice to dig into the possibility of adding online multiplayer.

A few of things happened.
1. There is a super basic, crazy, online version in the latest update.
You may try it, but the game is not gonna work as intended. 
You will however be able to connect to other players.
WARNING, it is not stable or tested properly and probably will not be there for long.
So try it at your own peril. It might crash the game.

2. In order to fully understand online multiplayer I did a course.
This resoulted in a new small game that will soon be available on Steam Early Access. 
It's just a small game that I used while doing the course, and I hope to find a way of including it in Pet Squad Racing, as a Thank you to all who have bought and tried it so far!
Keep an eye out, I will post an update when it is time.

3. Pet Squad Racing will not easily get a fully functioning online multiplayer feature. BUT, I will keep investigating on how I can implement it. Maybe as a mini game or so.

Anyhow.
Main fixes for this update is:
-Unflippable cars.
-Updated maps.
-Updated Checkpoints.
-Updated collisions.
-Crazy test online multiplayer.

Peace y'all!

/Tomas
